assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable transparent presentation character sticker, one square 1024x1024 PNG.
Input image 1 is a CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE, not a layout to reproduce. Create exactly ONE full-body Jelly-woo character in a new human-approval pose.
Identity: cheerful glossy orange bean-shaped body, one black curled hair sprout, large expressive white eyes with dark pupils, dark eyebrows, pink cheeks, small single front tooth; charcoal-black hoodie with simple white </> symbol, small dark backpack, black headphones with blue accent rings resting around neck, rounded black shoes. Match reference's polished soft 3D toy illustration faithfully.
Pose: standing steadily, body turned slightly toward the RIGHT to face slide content when placed on the left. Calm confident smile, eyes open. Holding up one cream document with exactly ONE large green checkmark prominently visible, and giving a clear thumbs-up with the other hand beside the document. This means a person has reviewed and approved the work before execution. No shield, no magnifying glass, no pencil, no celebration jump. Keep the hands anatomically clear and props separate from face.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, no white rectangle, no checkerboard, no scenery, no surface. Full feet and curl visible; generous transparent margin, no cropping. Character fills about 85% of square height with a silhouette clear at 190px.
Style: friendly high-quality 3D mascot, soft studio lighting, same material and color palette as reference. Only one character. No written words, labels, letters, numbers, title, watermark, panels or contact sheet. Only permitted symbols: white hoodie </> and single document checkmark.
